item.title: View Alert List
item.description: This section describes how to view the global alert list. The Built-in Alerts and Custom Alerts pages under Global Alerts display alerts generated by the system based on global alert rule groups, and do not include alerts generated by the system based on cluster and project alert rule groups. Prerequisites You need to have the platform-admin role in the KubeSphere platform. For more information, refer to Users and Platform Roles.
